groups.rationale: Antithesis admission-stub profile: 17-reference documents the harness stub storage substrate (configured pool totals, measured cgroup compute, digest-verified non-bootable stub image), real Marshall admission, the SQL setup probe, and that results are not ZFS, capacity, KVM or isolation evidence.

A VM actor no longer re-drives a command whose failed outcome it has durably recorded; it re-observes once after an actor restart and runs any newer command at once. Chapter 04 replaces the per-second retry gap with this behaviour and its property tests; ADR-0176 gains evidence.
Only 17-reference prose for the Antithesis admission-stub harness profile changed; no protocol source or wire format changed.

Lilly runtime gains a stub-backed placement-readiness branch only inside the compile-time ANTITHESIS_HARNESS controlled-executor build; production and guest/integrated harness releases compile unchanged, so storage, lifecycle and security chapters are unaffected. The harness branch is documented in 17-reference.
Runtime Covenant edge tests add executable verification without changing architecture, operations, topology, or documented boundaries.
Runtime coverage artifact refresh records Covenant results without changing architecture, operations, topology, or documented boundaries.
Only 17-reference prose for the Antithesis admission-stub harness profile changed; governance tooling, coverage and security chapters are unchanged.
